name: Keyhaven
summary: An estate agency landing page with a drawn hero film and a live property search
about: A one-page site for an estate agent or property developer. A drawn golden-hour film pans across a skyline and a villa street behind the hero, and the search bar filters twelve listings by area, type, budget and beds with smooth card shuffles. Services, agents, client stories and a valuation form complete the page.
how: The letterbox opens, a title card cuts in and the drawn film starts panning across the street; pause or play it any time
Type an area to get suggestions, pick a type, budget and beds, then press Search homes
The listings below shuffle to show only matching homes, with a live count; chips and the sort menu refine them further
Tap the heart to save a home, or Book a viewing to send its details into the contact form
Sections slide in as you scroll: services, count-up numbers, agents and a swipeable story slider
Fill in the call-back form; it checks each field, runs through its sending steps and celebrates when done
